faq: Do you need to see my existing code?
Yes. You add us to your repository as a collaborator, and we read the code before quoting any change. If there is no code yet, order MVP Build instead, which starts from nothing.
How do we agree what each feature does?
We write a short description with the screens, rules and edge cases, and you approve it before we code. That keeps arguments about what was meant out of the process.
Which languages and frameworks do you work in?
Mostly JavaScript and TypeScript with React or Next.js and Node, plus Python and PHP on request. Tell us your stack in the order form and we confirm before you pay for anything.
Will the new features break what already works?
We run your existing tests and add our own, and we work on a separate branch. Nothing reaches your live product until you have reviewed and merged it.
